Linde utilizes three basic distribution methods for its industrial gases, which are selected based on factors like customer volume requirements and location [1]. 
For on-site or tonnage delivery, Linde constructs cryogenic and process gas plants on or adjacent to customers requiring the largest volumes with relatively constant demand, supplying the product directly by pipeline [1]. 
Merchant or bulk liquid delivery involves shipping products such as oxygen, nitrogen, argon, hydrogen, and helium, often utilizing vessels where merchant oxygen and nitrogen are leased to the customer and have a relatively small distribution radius [2]. 
Packaged or cylinder gases supply customers requiring small volumes with products in metal containers under medium to high pressure, which may be delivered to the customer's site or picked up at a packaging facility or retail store [2]. 
Additionally, Linde manufactures and distributes its industrial gas products through extensive networks that include production plants, pipeline complexes, distribution centers, and delivery vehicles [3].
